title: NorthRiver Analytics
text: NorthRiver Analytics is a analytics company headquartered in Dublin. It was founded in 2016 by Elena Park. Its flagship product is RiverLens, which launched in 2019. In 2021, NorthRiver Analytics acquired Delta Insight, a company based in Berlin.

title: Delta Insight
text: Delta Insight is a geospatial analytics company headquartered in Berlin. It was founded in 2014 by Martin Hale. Its flagship product is DeltaMap, which launched in 2017.

title: Asteron Labs
text: Asteron Labs is a workflow automation company headquartered in Amsterdam. It was founded in 2018 by Priya Raman. Its flagship product is AsterFlow, which launched in 2020.

title: BlueHarbor Systems
text: BlueHarbor Systems is a maritime software company headquartered in Copenhagen. It was founded in 2012 by Jonas Weber. Its flagship product is HarborOS, which launched in 2015. In 2022, BlueHarbor Systems acquired SignalForge, a company based in Oslo.

title: Crescent AI
text: Crescent AI is a language technology company headquartered in Paris. It was founded in 2019 by Lina Haddad. Its flagship product is Crescent Core, which launched in 2021.

title: MapleGrid Energy
text: MapleGrid Energy is a energy software company headquartered in Toronto. It was founded in 2011 by Owen Clarke. Its flagship product is GridPilot, which launched in 2016. In 2020, MapleGrid Energy acquired HelioWorks, a company based in Vancouver.

title: QuantaForge
text: QuantaForge is a simulation software company headquartered in Stockholm. It was founded in 2015 by Mina Sørensen. Its flagship product is ForgeSim, which launched in 2018.

title: Solis Retail
text: Solis Retail is a retail platforms company headquartered in Madrid. It was founded in 2013 by Diego Alvarez. Its flagship product is SolisCart, which launched in 2016. In 2021, Solis Retail acquired BasketCloud, a company based in Lisbon.

title: Veridian Robotics
text: Veridian Robotics is a robotics company headquartered in Zurich. It was founded in 2017 by Naomi Ivers. Its flagship product is VeriArm, which launched in 2020.

title: Willow Health
text: Willow Health is a digital health company headquartered in Brussels. It was founded in 2010 by Tariq Mahmood. Its flagship product is WillowCare, which launched in 2014. In 2019, Willow Health acquired MedAxis, a company based in Antwerp.

title: Elena Park
text: Elena Park is the founder and CEO of NorthRiver Analytics. Before that, Elena Park worked as a data scientist at HarborMetrics. Elena Park is associated with Dublin.

title: Martin Hale
text: Martin Hale is the founder of Delta Insight. Before that, Martin Hale worked as a cartography researcher. Martin Hale is associated with Berlin.

title: Priya Raman
text: Priya Raman is the founder of Asteron Labs. Before that, Priya Raman worked as a workflow engineer. Priya Raman is associated with Amsterdam.

title: Jonas Weber
text: Jonas Weber is the founder of BlueHarbor Systems. Before that, Jonas Weber worked as a shipping operations analyst. Jonas Weber is associated with Copenhagen.

title: Lina Haddad
text: Lina Haddad is the founder of Crescent AI. Before that, Lina Haddad worked as a computational linguist. Lina Haddad is associated with Paris.

title: RiverLens
text: RiverLens is a product developed by NorthRiver Analytics. It launched in 2019. The product is associated with Dublin.

title: DeltaMap
text: DeltaMap is a product developed by Delta Insight. It launched in 2017. The product is associated with Berlin.

title: AsterFlow
text: AsterFlow is a product developed by Asteron Labs. It launched in 2020. The product is associated with Amsterdam.

title: HarborOS
text: HarborOS is a product developed by BlueHarbor Systems. It launched in 2015. The product is associated with Copenhagen.

title: Crescent Core
text: Crescent Core is a product developed by Crescent AI. It launched in 2021. The product is associated with Paris.

title: NorthRiver Analytics acquisition of Delta Insight
text: In 2021, NorthRiver Analytics acquired Delta Insight. Delta Insight was based in Berlin.

title: BlueHarbor Systems acquisition of SignalForge
text: In 2022, BlueHarbor Systems acquired SignalForge. SignalForge was based in Oslo.

title: MapleGrid Energy acquisition of HelioWorks
text: In 2020, MapleGrid Energy acquired HelioWorks. HelioWorks was based in Vancouver.

title: Solis Retail acquisition of BasketCloud
text: In 2021, Solis Retail acquired BasketCloud. BasketCloud was based in Lisbon.

title: Willow Health acquisition of MedAxis
text: In 2019, Willow Health acquired MedAxis. MedAxis was based in Antwerp.

title: European offices
text: NorthRiver Analytics operates in Dublin. Delta Insight operates in Berlin. Asteron Labs operates in Amsterdam. BlueHarbor Systems operates in Copenhagen.

title: Language technology notes
text: Crescent AI is headquartered in Paris and launched Crescent Core in 2021. NorthRiver Analytics focuses on analytics rather than language technology.

title: Health and robotics notes
text: Veridian Robotics is headquartered in Zurich. Willow Health is headquartered in Brussels and acquired MedAxis in 2019.

title: Product launches
text: RiverLens launched in 2019. AsterFlow launched in 2020. HarborOS launched in 2015. GridPilot launched in 2016.

title: Acquisition timeline
text: MapleGrid Energy acquired HelioWorks in 2020. NorthRiver Analytics acquired Delta Insight in 2021. BlueHarbor Systems acquired SignalForge in 2022. Solis Retail acquired BasketCloud in 2021.
